description: Discover what this FL Studio build and session can do. Call first. Capabilities with supported=false must be reported to the user as unavailable, not worked around.
name: fls_get_capabilities

description: Partial project summary. Every field carries status, source and age; report 'unavailable' fields as unknown instead of guessing.
name: fls_get_project_summary

description: Request a fresh capture of the notes FL exposes in the Piano Roll. scope must be chosen explicitly: 'selected' (an empty selection captures nothing) or 'all_exposed'. Returns a job in state awaiting_fl_action: tell the user the exact next_action and poll fls_get_job.
name: fls_capture_score

description: Read an immutable captured snapshot. It is cached data; check freshness before relying on it. note_id values are only valid within this snapshot.
name: fls_get_snapshot

note.default: Cached capture; the live score may have changed since.
note.title: Note

fl.description: All other readable FL properties in native units
fl.title: Fl

description: Deterministic analysis of a snapshot: motifs, ranked key/chord hypotheses and likely pitch outliers. Findings are suggestions with evidence, not certainty. key_hint is treated as a user constraint; an inferred key is only a hypothesis.

key_hint.description: User-specified key such as 'C major'; treated as a constraint
key_hint.title: Key Hint

name: fls_analyze_score

key_hint.description: User-specified key such as 'C major'; treated as a constraint
key_hint.title: Key Hint

description: Validate operations (note.update / note.insert / note.delete) against a snapshot and create an immutable plan with an exact diff and plan_hash. Propose the smallest patch that satisfies the request. Proposing never edits FL.

NoteSet.description: Allowlisted fields an update may change. Omitted fields are untouched.
NoteSet.title: NoteSet

NoteTemplate.description: A new note. Omitted optional fields are filled from the captured default note.
NoteTemplate.title: NoteTemplate

name: fls_propose_patch

NoteSet.description: Allowlisted fields an update may change. Omitted fields are untouched.
NoteSet.title: NoteSet

NoteTemplate.description: A new note. Omitted optional fields are filled from the captured default note.
NoteTemplate.title: NoteTemplate

description: Show a plan's exact diff, limits, warnings, staleness and whether an existing grant covers it.
name: fls_preview_plan

NoteSet.description: Allowlisted fields an update may change. Omitted fields are untouched.
NoteSet.title: NoteSet

NoteTemplate.description: A new note. Omitted optional fields are filled from the captured default note.
NoteTemplate.title: NoteTemplate

description: Request application of an immutable plan; may require an FL-side action. Needs an existing grant (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise: ask the user to approve in the FL Slacker UI). Returns a job; the edit is only done when fls_get_job reports state 'applied' with a verified receipt.
name: fls_apply_plan

description: Job status, the exact user action required next, errors, and the receipt once verified. Poll with bounded backoff.
name: fls_get_job

description: Cancel queued work you created. Succeeds only before FL acts; it never rolls back an edit.
name: fls_cancel_job

description: Build and request a guarded inverse plan for a verified receipt. Only works while the score still equals the recorded after-state; it is not a global Undo. Needs a covering grant.
name: fls_restore_edit
